                    ### Question
                    Choose the drug which blocks basal as well as stimulated gastric acid secretion without affecting cholinergic, histaminergic or gastrin receptors

                    ### Options
                    opa. Loxatidine
opb. Pirenzepine
opc. Omeprazole
opd. Famotidine

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Omeprazole, a proton pump inhibitor, effectively blocks both basal and stimulated gastric acid secretion by inhibiting the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme system in the gastric parietal cell. It does not affect cholinergic, histaminergic, or gastrin receptors, making it the suitable choice per the given criteria.
